name: v4.0.0_rc0
body:
It took a long time, it took A LOT of work: I am happy to announce version 4.0!

- Modern-looking & GPU-accelerated interface, written in [Qt QML](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qtqml-index.html)
- A new math parsing library, [ZeCalculator](https://github.com/AdelKS/ZeCalculator)
  - Useful error messages that point at what is wrong in the expression
  - An arbitrary number of objects
  - Every object can be called in the expression of any other
- Constants that slide between two bounds, by hand or as an animation, or that
  take several values at once to draw a whole family of curves
- Data sheets: CSV import and export, a table to edit the values, and columns
  filled from any object
- Improved parametric plots
- Export to SVG, PDF and image formats, exactly as it looks on the screen
- Save your work. Your latest work is also automatically saved and restored on the next start
- The manual of the website, inside the app
- Support for new languages (AI translated): French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese,
  Russian, Japanese and Chinese
- Near-complete rewrite of the code base

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AdelKS/ZeGrapher/compare/v3.1.1...v4.0.0_rc0

name: v3.1.1
body:
Hello everyone,

A small update before the big one, featuring:
- Chinese translation, a big thank you to the Chinese Culture University of Taipei. Now ZeGrapher will be everywhere!
- Automatically produce Mac dmg files! Now Mac will have its packages at the same time as the other OSes, finally! Travis-CI is a really nice tool.
- A few visual fixes
- Add Tab as separator in CSV files
- Some other minor changes, like saying that ZeGrapher needs to be restarted after an app setting change.

See you soon for another release!

name: v3.1
body: Hello all, A small update, as usual after a long time, featuring: - A new logo ! Hope you like it, I thought that the butterfly curve became ZeGrapher's mascot now :) - A brand new website ! Based on a template made by HTML 5 Up. Pay it a visit here https://zegrapher.com ! - Smoother animations - For once, the mac version follows (though the text inside the graph seems blurry, unfortunately I didn't have the time to check where it came from) - A bit of code refactoring, that will be carried to the next version I have been working on for a long time I will continue the work on the next version (in the master branch) and I hope to finish it this year :) See you, Adel

name: v3.0.2
body:
Well...

A little update cumulating bug corrections, nothing much new besides that.

Anyway, see you for another release !

name: v3.0.1
body:
Hi!

I just discovered, thanks to a feedback from a user, and fixed a shameful mistake: the computed coefficients of the regression polynomials were sometimes wrong... It was due to only one line of code where the wrong variable were used. Anyway, now it's fixed ! 
There were also some minor bug fixes.

See ya soon for the next release.

name: v3.0
body:
Three years after ZeGrapher v2.0 release, I am happy to announce ZeGrapher's new version ! :smile: 

The main new feature is plotting and fitting 2D experimental data. Of course a lot of small things have been changed! I'll let you discover them all by yourself.

Here are the links to get this version before the others:
[Zegrapher v3.0 for Linux 64bit](http://zegrapher.com/download/ZeGrapher_v3.0_Linux_64bit.7z)
[Zegrapher v3.0 for Linux 32bit](http://zegrapher.com/download/ZeGrapher_v3.0_Linux_32bit.7z)
[Zegrapher v3.0 for Windows](http://zegrapher.com/download/ZeGrapher_v3.0_Windows.7z)

Of course, as usual, Mac users will have to wait... How much time ? Good question.

See you "soon" for another release :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
